create_text_to_audio_pipeline: create a text-to-audio pipeline using the TextToAudioPipeline class to generate audio from input text
generate_audio_from_text: generate audio waveform from text input using the TextToAudioPipeline __call__ method
generate_music_with_parameters: generate music from text with custom generate_kwargs like temperature and max_new_tokens
build_pipeline_with_vocoder: build a text-to-audio pipeline with a custom vocoder for spectrogram-to-waveform conversion
process_chat_formatted_text: process chat-formatted text inputs through the pipeline using apply_chat_template for audio generation
